288:t_2:68.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... So you disposed of them.」

288:t_2:71.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「As I thought... You're the $$破嵐万丈$$ I've heard about.」

288:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$... I've heard about you too.」

288:t_2:73.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Yin and yang meet... Is this what they call a bond?」

288:t_2:74.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I already know you stand above $$クロノ$$.」

288:t_2:76.en:
$$万丈$$
「I swear upon this red earth. I will not tolerate your existence.」

289:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All $c ships have descended into the Martian atmosphere.」

289:t_000:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「This takes me back... We haven't been here since the final battle of the $$再世戦争$$.」

289:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Here we defeated Prince $$ユーサー$$ of $$インサラウム$$, sealed $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, and settled things with $$ガイオウ$$, $$破界の王$$...」

289:t_001:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「So the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ really has stopped functioning...」

289:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Otherwise, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ wouldn't have returned.」

289:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「According to $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$, anyone who draws out $$次元力$$ cannot escape a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on their own once sealed inside.」

289:t_001:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Then someone must have awakened that dangerous man from his slumber.」

289:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Who would do that, and why...?」

289:t_001:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, let's hear what they have to say.」

289:t_002:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...We've come to welcome you, members of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

289:t_002:2.en:
$$ボビー$$
「You're 《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$アークセイバー$$》s.」

289:t_002:3.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We too are now members of the $$地球連邦$$.」

289:t_002:4.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You must be tired from your long journey. We'll guide you to our residential area.」

289:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$ユーサー・インサラウム$$... What you did was not in vain.)

289:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(They live alongside us now. As our brethren, moving toward the future together.)

289:t_002:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(So rest in peace. $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, Holy King $$インサラウム$$.)

294:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

294:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So you were sent to Southeast Asia...」

294:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... We took refuge in $$クメン$$ and stayed with our old friends.」

294:t_1:6.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「In $$クメン$$, besides $$ポタリア$$'s guerrilla organization, 《$$マーティアル$$》 is also fighting $$サイデリアル$$.」

294:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「You'd joined up with them too, $$シャッコ$$.」

294:t_1:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$マーティアル$$... The religion from $$アストラギウス$$ that teaches fighting makes humanity evolve...」

294:t_1:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's how she became our ally...?」

294:t_1:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$... As you know, a former 《$$ネクスタント$$》 of $$マーティアル$$.」

294:t_1:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テイタニア$$ left $$マーティアル$$. They're hunting her because of it.」

294:t_1:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「So she took refuge with us...?」

294:t_1:16.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Stop it. $$フィアナ$$'s death wasn't that woman's fault, or anyone else's.」

294:t_1:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ said it was fine. It isn't our place to argue.」

294:t_1:21.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(The feelings $$フィアナ$$ entrusted to me... I will keep pursuing $$キリコ$$...)

294:t_1:22.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(That is the meaning of my life.)

294:t_1:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I heard you were operating separately then, $$宗介$$...」

294:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「I gathered intelligence on $$アマルガム$$ while fighting in $$ナムサク$$'s arena.」

294:t_1:25.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The arena... Where they make a spectacle out of AS and AT battles?」

294:t_1:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's not all. The spectators bet on the outcome.」

294:t_1:27.en:
$$マオ$$
「A lot of money changes hands. It was probably one of $$アマルガム$$'s sources of funding.」

294:t_1:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that white and blue $$サベージ$$ the machine you used there?」

294:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「Its name is $$アル$$ II... No, $$クロスボウ$$.」

294:t_1:30.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ナミ$$... I'll never forget the time I spent with you.)

294:t_1:31.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レモン$$ will protect you. Forget that you're a $$ウィスパード$$, and stay alive...)

294:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, I'm glad... The $$アーバレスト$$ is safe too.」

294:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「It has neither $$アル$$ nor a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. You might say it's an empty shell.」

294:t_1:34.en:
$$マオ$$
「...$$ミスリル$$'s major facilities, including $$メリダ島$$, were destroyed by $$アマルガム$$ working with $$サイデリアル$$.」

294:t_1:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ barely escaped $$メリダ島$$ alive, but old $$カリーニン$$ went missing in that battle.」

294:t_1:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't look like that, $$バナージ$$. The major wouldn't die so easily.」

294:t_1:39.en:
$$マオ$$
「And $$ミスリル$$ isn't completely dead. The survivors are each continuing to fight as guerrillas.」

294:t_1:40.en:
$$マオ$$
「They're also the ones who repaired the $$アーバレスト$$, empty shell or not.」

294:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even without $$アル$$ or the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$, I will fight.」

294:t_1:44.en:
$$クルツ$$
「After all that, we left Southeast Asia and headed to $$スコート・ラボ$$ in North America.」

294:t_1:45.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And you met those people there.」

294:t_1:46.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「...So you were helping Dr. $$トライア$$ research super-dimensional physics, $$桂$$?」

294:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「I wouldn't call it helping... She mainly used me as a guinea pig.」

294:t_1:48.en:
$$モーム$$
「But thanks to you, the doctor's research seems to have made real progress.」

294:t_1:49.en:
$$桂$$
「After all, she's been holed up in a secret facility apart from the lab to hide from $$サイデリアル$$.」

294:t_1:52.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But what surprised me most was Dr. $$トライア$$'s $$リモネシア$$ report.」

294:t_1:53.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I never imagined the ancient ruins found in $$リモネシア$$ near the end of the $$時獄戦役$$ were left by our world's $$プロトカルチャー$$...」

294:t_1:54.en:
$$クラン$$
「So the $$プロトカルチャー$$ could travel between parallel worlds?」

294:t_1:55.en:
$$ルカ$$
「And records left in those ruins revealed how the universe collapses every 12,000 years.」
